label: August 3–9, 2026
intro: Post-holiday calm — quietest Marvel queues of the month, Toob North makers still cooking at Cloud 11, and BICT Fest tickets opening soon. Lock in your August plans this week.
weekday_note: Weekday Sub-Zero sessions (100 THB kids) are near-empty in August — the best ice practice window all summer.

activities.title: The Marvel Experience Thailand
activities.date: Saturday or Sunday — book on Klook
activities.location: Mega Bangna, Bang Phli (BTS On Nut + Grab ~30 min)
activities.price: Discounted on Klook (up to 45% off vs door price)
activities.why: Post-holiday August week means shortest queues of the summer. Iron Man's Stark Mobile Lab, 4D stereoscopic dome, VR flight training, and meet-and-greets with Iron Man, Thor the Avenger, Spider-Man, and Hulk. If you've been waiting to go, now is the time.
activities.tip: Book Klook tickets in advance. Arrive 15 mins early, catch the first dome session of the day. Allow 2 hours minimum.

activities.title: Toob North at theCOMMONS Cloud 11
activities.price: Free to browse; workshop sessions priced individually
activities.why: Northern Thai makers from Chiang Mai are still in residence — potters, weavers, food artisans. Watch live clay work, try hands-on sessions, eat northern food. August is quieter than the holiday rush, meaning more time with the makers.
activities.tip: August weekday sessions are more personal — makers have more time for curious 5-year-olds. Arrive at opening.

activities.title: Roller Dome Emporium — Weekend Session
activities.location: Roller Dome, Emporium Mall, Sukhumvit Soi 24 (Phrom Phong BTS)
activities.price: 150 THB/hr weekends; 100 THB/hr weekdays; skate + gear included
activities.why: Regular rollerblading practice is how Thor's skill builds week on week. Dedicated beginners grass area, coaches available. Post-holiday August weekends are less crowded than July.
activities.tip: Sunday morning 10–11am is consistently the quietest slot.

activities.title: Sub-Zero Ice Skating — Weekday Session
activities.date: Any weekday (call ahead to confirm hours)
activities.location: Sub-Zero Ice Skate Club, Major Cineplex Sukhumvit (Ekkamai BTS, skywalk access)
activities.price: 100 THB kids / 200 THB adults; Wednesday discount: 90 THB/hr; skate rental included
activities.why: August weekday afternoons at Sub-Zero are blissfully quiet — two dedicated rinks: Arena Rink (fun) and Academy Rink (coaching). Great for building ice confidence at Thor's own pace without the weekend crowd.
activities.tip: A 60-min lesson (~900 THB) produces noticeable progress in a single visit — the coaches are patient with young beginners.

activities.title: Children's Discovery Museum
activities.location: Queen Sirikit Park, Chatuchak (Mo Chit BTS or Chatuchak Park MRT)
activities.why: Giant bubbles, dinosaur digs, tunnel of mirrors, Lego building zones, and an outdoor water park. Free, interactive, and hands-on — perfect rainy-season afternoon when you want something educational and fun without the mall chaos.
activities.tip: Weekday visits have far fewer crowds. The outdoor water area is perfect for hot afternoons — bring a change of clothes.

activities.title: Kad Kokoa Kids Bonbon Chocolate Workshop
activities.date: Monthly sessions — check kadkokoa.co for upcoming dates
activities.price: Check kadkokoa.co for current session price
activities.why: Monthly small-group bonbon-making for kids using real Thai craft chocolate. Thor makes his own and takes them home. Book the August slot this week before it fills.
activities.tip: Follow Kad Kokoa on LINE Official for new date alerts — slots go fast.

activities.title: 🎭 Coming Up: BICT Fest — Bangkok Children's Theatre Festival
activities.date: August 21–30 — book tickets NOW at bictfest.com
activities.location: One Bangkok Park + Goethe-Institut Thailand + Sodsai Centre, Chulalongkorn Univ.
activities.price: Free programmes available + ticketed shows on Eventpop
activities.why: 10th anniversary BICT Fest: 11 interactive performances from 9 countries. Theme 'Play Attention: Look Who's Growing Up!' — participatory shows where kids are part of the action, designed for babies through teens. World-class programme, rare in Bangkok.
activities.tip: Free programme slots open early and disappear fast. Go to bictfest.com this week — don't wait until August 21.
